name: nebula-landing-page-audit
description: Evidence-grade landing page audit. Detects conversion leaks across 9 signals (headline, CTA, social proof, message match, mobile, load speed, SEO, ad signals, AI readiness). Every finding is prioritized by impact × effort with a specific fix. Free, no API key required.

tools.name: run_audit
tools.description: Run a full evidence-grade landing page audit against any public URL. Returns score (0–10), grade, and structured findings with prioritized fixes.

tools.name: compare_audits
tools.description: Audit two URLs and compare them side by side. Useful for benchmarking against a competitor or comparing variants.

tools.name: get_audit
tools.description: Retrieve a completed audit by its UUID.

tools.name: recent_audits
tools.description: List the most recent audits in the Nebula database.
